resources.string: OmniLink Remote uses the Accessibility Service solely to enable authorized remote users to perform touch gestures (tap, swipe, scroll) and system navigation (Back, Home, Recents) during an active, user-approved remote support session. No personal data, keystrokes, or screen content is logged or shared without consent.
